title: JSX workflow authoring
summary: Author durable workflows as JSX/TSX files (Workflow, Sequence, Parallel, Loop, Task, Approval, Branch, Worktree) with zod-typed outputs via createSmithers. Seeded init pack ships editable workflows under .smithers/workflows.
userValue: Write a multi-agent plan as a small typed TSX file and run it durably.

capabilities.title: Typed outputs
capabilities.detail: createSmithers binds zod/v4 schemas to task outputs and deps.

capabilities.title: Control flow
capabilities.detail: Sequence, Parallel, Loop with until/maxIterations, Branch, conditional rendering.

capabilities.title: Compute nodes
capabilities.detail: Function children run real shell/git work inside the durable graph.

title: smithers CLI
summary: The smithers bin (apps/cli): init, workflow list/run, up, ps, inspect, output, monitor, migrate, gateway, ui, agent management, MCP server. Some read paths have had backend-coupling bugs (sqlite-only reads, camelCase output flags).
userValue: Drive every workflow, run, and agent from one command-line tool.

capabilities.title: Run lifecycle
capabilities.detail: workflow run, up, ps, inspect, output, retry-task, resume.

capabilities.title: Init pack
capabilities.detail: smithers init seeds workflows, skills, agents, and the durable init system workflow.

missing: CLI read commands have historically been sqlite-coupled; keep pglite/postgres parity covered by e2e for every read command

title: Durable engine, scheduler, and driver
summary: The core control plane: renders the workflow graph, schedules tasks with retries/timeouts/heartbeats, persists every decision to the store, and survives process death. Two-path caveat: decisions live in WorkflowDriver/makeWorkflowSession.decide(), not the legacy engine block.
userValue: Long agent runs keep going through crashes, rate limits, and restarts.

capabilities.title: Retries & timeouts
capabilities.detail: Per-task retries, timeoutMs, heartbeatTimeoutMs.

capabilities.title: Deadlock detection
capabilities.detail: DEPENDENCY_DEADLOCK instead of silent hangs on bad deps/needs keys.

title: Agent adapters
summary: Adapters for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Kimi, Amp, and Antigravity CLIs with account providers, pools, and failover. Kimi auth-setup failures are fatal to a run instead of failing over, so kimi stays out of default pools.
userValue: Mix the best model for each step: plan with one agent, implement with another.

capabilities.title: Provider pools
capabilities.detail: planning/review/implement pools with ordered failover in .smithers/agents.ts.

capabilities.title: Accounts
capabilities.detail: smithers agent add|list|remove manages per-account configDirs.

missing: Kimi auth-setup error should fail over to the next pool agent instead of failing the run

title: Gateway and server
summary: HTTP/WS gateway (packages/server, packages/gateway-client) exposing runs, live events, PTY, approvals, and workflow launch to UIs and remote clients, including shared-DB run attribution and serverless resume/cron tick endpoints.
userValue: Watch and control runs from any UI or remote client over one API.

capabilities.title: Live events
capabilities.detail: WebSocket run events power live UIs, including detached runs.

capabilities.title: Serverless tick
capabilities.detail: Resume/cron tick plus run-lease claims for serverless deployment.

missing: Serverless resume/cron tick and run-lease claims are new; add end-to-end proof beyond unit tests

title: Custom workflow UIs (smithers ui)
summary: Per-workflow custom UIs under .smithers/ui/*.tsx rendered through gateway-react and components packages, served by the smithers ui command with real-browser e2e harness support.
userValue: Give each workflow its own live dashboard without building a web app.

capabilities.title: Gateway hooks
capabilities.detail: gateway-react hooks bind UI components to live run state.

capabilities.title: Seeded UIs
capabilities.detail: Init pack workflows ship pre-built UIs via generated ui sources.

title: Time travel and replay
summary: Rewind, replay, fork, snapshot, and checkpoint-restore over persisted runs (packages/time-travel plus MCP tools). Core operations work; durability snapshots for agent worktrees are phased in behind a flag.
userValue: Step back through a run, fork it, and try a different path without rerunning everything.

capabilities.title: Rewind & fork
capabilities.detail: rewind_run, fork_run, replay_run over the persisted event log.

capabilities.title: Snapshots
capabilities.detail: jj-based durability snapshots (phase 1) behind SMITHERS_DURABILITY_SNAPSHOTS.

missing: Durability snapshots phase 2 (restore in test-only tool context) is not finished

title: Crash recovery and resume
summary: Runs resume after process death, quota exhaustion, or machine restart; retry-task recovers hard-failed nodes without honoring spent attempts. Editing a running workflow file still hard-fails resume with RESUME_METADATA_MISMATCH by design.
userValue: Kill the process mid-run and pick up exactly where it stopped.

capabilities.title: Resume
capabilities.detail: smithers up/resume restores in-flight runs from the store.

capabilities.title: Quota recovery
capabilities.detail: retry-task recovers runs that exhausted retries on provider rate limits.

missing: Crash-recovery workflow (.smithers/workflows/crash-recovery.tsx) is new and unverified end to end

title: Sandboxes, worktrees, and VCS
summary: Isolated per-task worktrees (jj-first with git fallback), Cloudflare sandbox backend, and VCS plumbing. Chained-worktree workflows can hit jj bookmark conflicts after git commits, forcing the git-worktree fallback.
userValue: Agents work in isolated copies of the repo so parallel work cannot stomp your tree.

capabilities.title: Worktree component
capabilities.detail: <Worktree> gives each task an isolated checkout; agents must not pin cwd.

capabilities.title: Cloud sandbox
capabilities.detail: Cloudflare sandbox backend for remote execution.

missing: jj bookmark conflicts from git commits in chained worktrees need an automated repair path

title: Open code review
summary: The open-code-review workflow backed by apps/review: reviews PRs with real agents, posts findings, and has a metered cloud deployment. Cloud path is blocked on funding the API key.
userValue: Run an agent review pass over any PR, locally or as a hosted service.
missing: Cloud deployment blocked on a funded ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

title: Agent memory
summary: The memory package persists agent memories across runs so workflows can carry durable lessons between sessions.
userValue: Agents remember durable lessons from previous runs.
missing: No end-to-end proof that seeded workflows read and write memory across separate runs

title: Observability
summary: Metrics, logging, tracing, and OTLP exporters in apps/observability, exported as smithers-orchestrator/observability. Integrations exist but exporter installation into real deployments is uneven.
userValue: See what every run and agent did in your existing metrics and tracing stack.
missing: OTLP exporter is not installed in the reference deployments; prove a real export path

title: Docs pipeline and llms bundles
summary: Mintlify docs under docs/ with generated llms-*.txt bundles from a fixed manifest, gated in CI by check-docs and check-llms. Regenerate with pnpm docs:llms after editing docs.
userValue: Humans and agents read the same current docs, bundled for LLM consumption.

title: Docs driven development
summary: This workflow: a living product spec (.smithers/spec/features.json plus WYSIWYG content) with an audit, spec-update, triage, implement, review improvement loop and a five-tab custom UI.
userValue: Keep an honest, always-current spec of the product, review what changed across docs, audits, tickets, and live runs, then let agents burn down the highest-value gaps without losing the product narrative.

capabilities.title: Build gate
capabilities.detail: bun .smithers/lib/ddd/build.ts validates features.json and regenerates derived docs and UI modules.

capabilities.title: Improvement loop
capabilities.detail: bootstrap, metaTicket, audit, spec-update, triage, materialize-tickets, work, cycle-review, round-summary.

missing: Image upload target: Crepe ImageBlock needs an asset server; v1 wires ?assetBaseUrl passthrough but ships no asset server (uploads disabled when absent)
